It meets AB at M=(2,3/2), AC at N=(25/8,0), and BC only at y=-7/6 outside the triangle. Thus the entire crease in the paper is MN. Its length sqrt((9/8)^2+(3/2)^2)=sqrt225/64=15/8, uniquely D.
